text:
ana: FYI — kicked off a short sync thread to align on the OSS reference app launch, the benchmark narrative we show, webinar plan, and inbound routing. doc: https://tiny.redwood/oss-ref-studio (working draft)

matt: looks good, can we make the benchmark story > latency+cost? devs care about "real requests", not synthetic numbers.

jay: +1 to real workloads. suggest a small section showing 3 run configs: dev (cpu), staging (small gpu), prod (dedicated). show tokens/sec and $/1M tokens.

remi: for the webinar — propose this flow: 10m intro + 20m demo (ref app walkthrough) + 15m benchmarks deep-dive + 15m q&a. CTA: signup for early access to the starter kit.

marie: inbound routing note: please include UTM params & single-click contact capture. we'll route leads with utm_source=webinar and tag as "refapp-webinar" in HubSpot. Can Ops set up a landing /hidden form?

ana: @ops-bot can you remind infra to spin a small prod-like instance for the demo so latency numbers are stable? demo needs reproducible runbook.

ops-bot: scheduled: create-demo-instance job queued (ETA 4h). Job id: demo-20240430-81.

matt: messaging iteration idea: two short headlines — "Ship LLM features at production scale" vs "Inference that saves you money" — A/B test on the blog and webinar signup modal.

jay: for benchmark artifacts: provide a simple script snippet so others can reproduce. something like:

```bash
python run_bench.py --model redwood-7b --seq 1024 --batch 8 --tokens 100000 
```

remi: webinar ops: I can own slides + demo script. need a 30m dry run 2 days before. who can present? @ana?

ana: I can present the demo. remi, can you slot the dry run Tuesday at 11am?

marie: lead flow: after signup, send 3-email drip: 1) immediate welcome + starter kit link, 2) 24h follow-up with benchmark highlights, 3) 7d case study + request for trial. tag and route to AE queue if engagement > 2 emails opened.

matt: add a tiny checklist for the blog: 1) TLDR with metrics 2) how-to snippet 3) interactive demo link 4) CTA to webinar & GH repo.

ana: action items: matt write headline options (due EOD), jay produce bench script + sample CSV (due Fri), remi build slide deck + schedule dry run (due Wed), marie setup hubspot routing + form (due Thu). I'll consolidate into the doc and draft the launch blog (first pass by Mon).

marie: I'll also add the HubSpot workflow JSON export to the doc so marketing ops can import.

ops-bot: reminder: demo-instance created successfully (job demo-20240430-81). IP: 10.2.14.23.

ana: sweet — thanks all. I'll ping this thread when the draft blog is up for quick review. :sparkles:
